messages.subject: Re: Shiny dataTable - conditional formatting
parts:
Hi Gabriela

There are a number of options for you.  All of them offer different tradeoffs.  They are:
. Use jquery library handsontable.  There are various implementations for R and shiny.
https://github.com/trestletech/shinyTable offers conditional formatting out of the box.

. You can use data tables adding the following to the definition of your data table
, rowCallback = I(
    'function( row, data ) {
        if (parseFloat(data[3]) >= 10) {
    $("td:eq(3)", row).css("background-color", "green");}
    else if (parseFloat(data[3]) >= 5.0) { $("td:eq(3)", row).css("background-color", "Orange");}
    else if (parseFloat(data[3]) < 5.0) { $("td:eq(3)", row).css("background-color", "Red");}
}'
  ) 

hope it helps

Enzo
